arguments.code:
head = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=30).polygon(6,17.32).extrude(5)
head = head.edges('>Z').chamfer(0.7)
shaft = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(5).extrude(30)
pitch=1.0
helix=cq.Wire.makeHelix(pitch,16,5)
cutter=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(5.08,-0.35),(4.65,0),(5.08,0.35)]).close().sweep(cq.Workplane(obj=helix),isFrenet=True)
shaft=shaft.cut(cutter)
result=shaft.union(head)

item.text: The initial silhouette matches at about 97% across the four views. I’m refining the thread pitch and head thickness to match the visible details.

arguments.code:
head = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=30).polygon(6,17.32).extrude(5.5)
head = head.edges('>Z').chamfer(0.7)
shaft = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(5).extrude(30)
helix=cq.Wire.makeHelix(1.25,16.5,5)
cutter=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(5.08,-0.3),(4.8,0),(5.08,0.3)]).close().sweep(cq.Workplane(obj=helix),isFrenet=True)
result=shaft.cut(cutter).union(head)
